notes: The vendor's blog announcement and its live plan card disagree on the free shape: the blog says 2 vCPU and 2 GB, the card says 1 vCPU and 512 MB. The card is the page served at the point of sale, so the record uses the card and the disagreement is written down rather than resolved. The free plan is gated by a stock window the vendor sets and has moved (a markup comment reads 2026-10-21, the notice and script read 2026-10-29); the page's script re-opens the order button after 2026-10-29. The checkout script handles a free order with no payment step unless the paid shared IPv4 add-on is chosen. The vendor's public catalog (updated 2026-11-01T02:02:30.000Z) lists the plan as out_of_stock after that time, and the page's catalog script disables the button of such a plan. Not established: the traffic allowance, and whether the server's order endpoint accepts a free order, which is behind a sign-in.
